title: UFOs over nuclear ICBMs as a message, not over data centers

tellings.quote: with nuclear ICBMs and so on so forth you know we can see them over the nuclear uh ICBMs and so that might be a message

related.note: Same subject, UFOs over nuclear ICBMs, but the core claim is that they are sending a message, unlike the waiting-for-humanity explanation.

plain: An unnamed researcher who appears as a guest says that UFOs are seen over nuclear ICBMs, meaning long-range nuclear missiles kept in silos, and that this might be a message to humanity. The guest says this in an episode with Jesse Michels about whether artificial intelligence is alien technology, contrasting the missile sites with data centers, where the objects are not reported.
